Heat Cramp Management: Oral rehydration salts restore depleted electrolytes during extended endurance exertion in heat.

step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Course Hazard Survey: Walk the race course to map blind intersections, road surface potholes, and currents.

Distance Classification Rules: Sprint multisport races feature shorter courses designed to test initial multi-sport pacing strategies.
Discipline Limiter Focus: Concentrated practice on weaker segments produces the greatest overall finishing time reductions.
Essential Gear Fit: Certified helmets must sit level above eyebrows and buckle snugly under chin.

Step 2 - Segment Distance Comparison: Analyze distance ratios between sprint, Olympic, and long-course multisport competitive race categories.
Step 3 - Equipment Readiness Audit: Assemble approved swim goggles, bicycle helmet, road-worthy bike, and cushioned running shoes.
Step 4 - Format Selection Conference: Select either triathlon, duathlon, aquathlon, or aquabike based on personal proficiency goals.
